ruleDefinitions.name: T1047 — WMI Lateral Movement, Plaintext Credential (Fact #27)
ruleDefinitions.description: WMI Lateral Movement, Plaintext Credential. Trigger: wmic.exe /node executes a remote process with credentials supplied in plaintext on the command line
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: A 4688 process-creation audit event was logged on {host} (command-line not visible via this builder)
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
